name: AI-enabled Artemis Deployment Profile
unresolvedNotes: pyris.url maps to artemis.iris.url and pyris.secretRef to artemis.iris.secret-token (application-artemis.yml:126-129). URLs are non-secret placeholders; the secret is stored as a reference only.
athena.url maps to artemis.athena.url and athena.secretRef to artemis.athena.secret (application-artemis.yml:84-86).

hyperion-service requires artemis.hyperion.enabled plus a configured Spring AI chat model (spring.ai.openai.base-url and api-key, application-artemis.yml:90-91,134-159). It is unclear whether a Deployment Profile should expose the full LLM endpoint or only signal that an external LLM provider is configured; see deployment-profile-open-questions.md.

lti-platform-registration, theia-service, and sharing-platform-registration/sharing-secret are intentionally not provided by either bootstrap profile because they depend on external registration or infrastructure (LTI platform registration is database-managed in Artemis, not a simple config key).
